one_minute_value_explanation: v10.7 lets AOF stop build/release-critical work when required roles and skills are only nominally present and not connected to concrete actor, output, evidence, acceptance, and Council review artifacts.
thirty_second_version_delta: v10.6 defined how validation results enter AOF; v10.7 prevents work from starting or shipping when required expertise coverage is missing.
product_review_trigger: If an operator cannot see which required roles/skills are missing before build, reopen capability coverage UX and audit design.
not_proven: Capability coverage does not prove semantic expert correctness, playtest truth, market truth, external adoption, or production safety.
